note: Idea backlog for the research desk Ideas tab. Statuses: proposed, testing, validated, shipped, dead. cost_wall records whether the idea's edge survives slippage+commissions - the recurring killer in this repo. Dead ideas are kept deliberately so they are not re-litigated.

ideas.title: Stop auto-logging Long Calls into the cohort
ideas.thesis: Long Call is -$17,620 over 98 closed trades at a 33% win rate, with a scorer IC of -0.020 (p=0.85). It is the only strategy the Phase-1 gate measures and the worst line in the book.
ideas.evidence: docs/PROFITABILITY_FINDINGS.md section 2; ds feeder logs 5 LC/day.
ideas.next_step: Decide whether the ds auto-log window keeps running. Continuing costs money to gather data on a signal that reads as zero.

ideas.title: Re-point Phase 1 at credit structures
ideas.thesis: Bear Call has the best scorer IC (+0.152) and Bull Put the best P&L (+$3,630 at 66% win). Both are short premium, consistent with every prior repo result. The gate ignores both.
ideas.next_step: Write a gate-redesign spec. DECISIONS.md 2026-06-07 forbids silent gate changes - propose, do not edit thresholds.

ideas.title: Fix the gate's incoherent power math
ideas.thesis: READY needs IC>=0.08 AND p<0.05, but proving IC=0.08 at p<0.05 requires n~601. At the n>=50 trigger, p<0.05 demands observed IC~0.286 - 3.6x the stated bar. The gate cannot fire on its own terms.
ideas.next_step: Pick one: size n to the effect, switch to a one-sided test, or gate on net-EV instead of IC.

ideas.title: Merge and paper-trade the BTC short-vol carry
ideas.thesis: BTC short-vol carry is the only strategy in this repo that has cleared the cost wall on its own numbers: NET +4 to +5.5 vol points, 68-74% hit rate.
ideas.evidence: src/crypto/volbacktest; branch NOT merged. ETH did not validate - BTC only.
ideas.next_step: Merge the branch and run it on the paper ledger before anything touches real money.

ideas.title: Re-examine the OOS-validated index put spread
ideas.thesis: Index put spreads validated out-of-sample on 7yr DoltHub EOD chains, but were shelved as capacity-walled. At retail size the capacity wall may not bind.
ideas.next_step: Quantify the capacity ceiling in dollars. If it exceeds intended size, the wall is irrelevant.

ideas.title: Test whether the scorer ranks days better than contracts
ideas.thesis: Collapsing the cohort to day-means lifts IC from +0.076 (n=57) to +0.249 (n=18). If it holds as n grows, the edge is in timing entries, not selecting contracts.
ideas.next_step: Re-measure at n>=40 entry days before drawing any conclusion.

ideas.title: Make take-profit thresholds cost-aware by spread width
ideas.thesis: A NFLX $1-wide spread hit its 50%-of-credit take-profit at +56% gross and settled at -1.5% net. Fixed percentage exits ignore that costs are a fixed dollar amount per contract.
ideas.next_step: Require modelled net P&L > 0 before a take-profit fires. Note: changes live exit behaviour across the open book and the gate cohort - deliberate decision, not a cleanup.

ideas.title: Count effective n, not nominal n, in the gate
ideas.thesis: Batch auto-logging clusters entries: 57 trades on 18 days, ICC +0.108, design effect 1.23, effective n ~46. The n>=50 trigger counts nominal trades and is therefore slightly overconfident.
ideas.next_step: Only matters if IC ever approaches the READY bar. Bundle with the gate-power redesign.

ideas.title: Surface a dead scheduler in maintenance_health
ideas.thesis: All three LaunchAgents exited 78 (EX_CONFIG) since ~2026-06-15. maintenance_health reads the state file, which the interactive path also stamps, so it showed mild staleness rather than 'scheduler dead'.
ideas.evidence: launchctl list; logs/launchagent.log stops 2026-06-15 while maintenance.log continues.
ideas.next_step: Have maintenance_health shell out to launchctl and check last exit status. Underlying fix is user-only: System Settings > Login Items > Allow in the Background.

ideas.title: Hold credit spreads to expiry instead of closing at 50% take-profit
ideas.thesis: Round-trip cost on a 2-leg vertical is a fixed $22.60. Letting an OTM spread expire worthless pays only the opening legs, halving the toll: Bear Call 48% of max profit -> 24%, Bull Put 18% -> 9%. At 700 CAD this is the single cheapest improvement available and needs no new signal.
ideas.evidence: docs/PROFITABILITY_FINDINGS.md section 7. Mechanism behind the NFLX +56% gross / -1.5% net exit.
ideas.next_step: Costs assignment risk against cost saving for ITM-at-expiry cases; the current take-profit rule exists partly to avoid that. Quantify before changing exit rules.

ideas.title: Prefer Bull Put over Bear Call purely on cost ratio at small size
ideas.thesis: Median Bull Put credit is $122.50 vs Bear Call $47.50. The same fixed $22.60 round-trip is 18% vs 48% of max profit. Nothing to do with edge - it is credit-per-trade against a fixed toll.
ideas.next_step: Confirm the credit gap is structural and not an artifact of which strikes the scanner happened to pick.

ideas.title: Use pop_score instead of quality_score as the ranker
ideas.thesis: pop_score is the only metric of 35 to survive FDR correction (IC +0.176, p=0.0005) - but it is a decoy. Its mean is rank-ordered by structure family, so aggregate POP merely re-discovers 'credit beats debit'. Within strategy it predicts nothing, and in Short Put it is significantly backwards (-0.305, p=0.007).
ideas.next_step: None. Any future metric claim must be tested WITHIN strategy before it is believed.

ideas.title: Cherry-pick only the highest quality_score trades for real money
ideas.thesis: Intuitive plan: skip the volume, trade only the best-scoring setup. Tested over 32 entry days / 393 closed trades - selectivity degrades results monotonically. Top-1 per day: 43.8% win, -$126/trade. All logged: 50.4% win, -$27/trade. The 0.85+ score bucket is the worst in the book (33% win, -$165/trade); long premium at 0.85+ is 23% win, -$270/trade.
ideas.evidence: docs/PROFITABILITY_FINDINGS.md section 5. Caveat: all CIs straddle zero, n=32 days - the monotone ordering across all/long/short panels is the real evidence, not any single cell.
ideas.next_step: None. Do not select on quality_score. If a selection rule is ever revisited it must be validated on held-out data first, not on this cohort.

ideas.title: Lottery sleeve
ideas.thesis: Negative-EV in backtest. Shelved as research, wired nowhere.
ideas.next_step: None. Do not revive without a materially different structure.

ideas.title: Breakout / tail-move probability engine
ideas.thesis: Honest no-edge result. The engine predicts tail moves no better than the chain already prices them.
ideas.next_step: None. Kept as a descriptive layer only.

ideas.title: Crypto perp directional signals
ideas.thesis: Four candidate signals, all dead net-of-cost. Reversion is gone entirely; daily trend-breakout has only modest gross edge that funding and fees consume.
ideas.evidence: src/crypto signals harness; leverage signal research (cost 22x short vs edge).
ideas.next_step: None. Carry is the surviving crypto path, not direction.

ideas.title: Single-name equity short-vol
ideas.thesis: No edge on single names. Index/SPY VRP is positive - the distinction is the whole result.
ideas.next_step: None for single names. The index leg is live in idea index-put-spread-capacity.
